# Wear OS

Every app in this list that runs on Wear OS. That is 9 apps with 4 for Plex and 6 for Jellyfin and 1 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [samsung-watch-plex-client](https://github.com/lucasscharf/samsung-watch-plex-client) - Samsung Galaxy Watch client. `Plex` · `Wear OS` · `GPL-3.0`

## Music

- [jellyfin-wearos](https://github.com/fimbulent/jellyfin-wearos) - Standalone Wear OS client that streams or downloads albums without a phone. `Jellyfin` · `Wear OS` · `GPL-3.0` `Free`
- [JellyWear](https://github.com/AndrewEllen/JellyWear) - Smartwatch client. `Jellyfin` · `Wear OS` · `GPL-3.0` `Free`
- [Namida](https://github.com/namidaco/namida) - Flutter music and video player with multiple libraries and offline caching for server sources. `Jellyfin` `+Subsonic` · `Windows` `Android` `Android Auto` `Wear OS` · `Open source`
- [Plex Wear](https://github.com/nedrichards/plex-wearos) - Standalone Wear OS app that plays Plex music on the watch and works as a remote. `Plex` · `Wear OS` · `GPL-3.0`
- [Symfonium](https://symfonium.app/) - Android music player that casts to Chromecast and Sonos groups. `Plex` `Jellyfin` `Emby` `+Subsonic` `+Audiobookshelf` `+Kodi` · `Android` `Android TV` `Android Auto` `Wear OS` · `Paid` · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.symfonik.music.player)
- [WearAmp](https://github.com/03c/WearAmp) - Standalone Wear OS music player. `Plex` · `Wear OS` · `GPL-3.0`
- [WearJelly](https://github.com/Nanakusa-Nazuna7/WearJelly) - Standalone Wear OS music player that works on the watch without a phone. `Jellyfin` · `Wear OS` · `Open source` `Free`

## Companions

- [JellyRemote](https://github.com/TeeWare2026/JellyRemote) - Android remote that browses the library, picks what plays and controls playback on another client. `Jellyfin` · `Android` `Wear OS` · `Open source`
